names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 13 февраля ст. ст., «Зоя Вифлеемская, прп.», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's third heading for 13. фебруар ст. ст., „Света Зоа и Фотонија.“, with Света left off, which is not a rank. The heading names the two women together and gives neither an epithet; Витлејем, the Bethlehem of her Russian form, is in the body and not in the heading.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 февраля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Зои и Фотинии (Светланы) (V).»

attestations.note: The Prologue's third heading names the two women together and its body treats them in one entry, so this row and `photina-of-palestine`'s quote the same line.
